reviews.title: They ripped me off
reviews.text: So i needed to find my friends phone she lost and i find this app on a google search. $2.99, OK I figured that was fair but there was never any mention of a $9.99 safety gesture which they charged me for twice! So just under $23.00 for a half hour on the app! Don’t get screwed don’t use this rip off service!

reviews.title: Billing
reviews.text:
I did a trial run and canceled within a day or 2 and I’m still being billed $39.00. 
I thought everything was cancelled, but my Apple Pay account keeps getting billed for $39, or $10 whichever they can take. Don’t use this app. It will spam you daily, weekly, monthly. Update:  now support is trying to say that I didn’t properly cancel my subscription which is a lie . I provided screenshots of my cancellation and they are still trying to take money. The next step is to report the business to BBB.

reviews.title: Auto renewal and errored out sign ins make this app unfriendly to use .
reviews.text: This app not only misleads you from the beginning into thinking you can use it for free . It also makes it almost impossible to cancel your subscription after it has been auto renewed without your permission after the trial period is over . When you try to sign in on the website with your already saved information from the set up , it tells you that there’s an error even though the information is correct . Conveniently on the subscriptions part of the page . Then when you go to your actual phone settings to cancel the subscription manually , it’s not even there as an option to chose . Do waste your time or money on this SCAM app . It might be able to track your loved ones , but only after you’ve gotten their permission . You can’t track without it . Which is misleading as well as the auto renewals !! 👎🏽👎🏽

reviews.title: I was charged 3 separate charges.
reviews.text: This is what I dislike of these apps. You make a payment for a specific amount of time then when you check your bank account, my blood pressure goes up when I see three charges that were not specified. What gives the right to an app you’re getting a specific product for a specific amount of time suddenly tack-on a few more charges they were not supposed to. So now, I have to tell my bank that I did not authorize al of the charges to my account.
